message.text: I will examine the proto files in proto/api/v1 to identify the gRPC/Connect services and count them.
Eight gRPC/Connect services are defined under proto/api/v1. Their names will be listed next.

q05.
8: AIService, AttachmentService, AuthService, IdentityProviderService, InstanceService, MemoService, ShortcutService, UserService

These are the `service` definitions under `proto/api/v1` (`ai_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `memo_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`). `common.proto` has no service.
